name: door-iron-powered
comment: BlockDoor.onNeighborBlockChange / onPoweredBlockChange: an iron door at x=2 and a wooden door at x=4 (lower half meta 0, upper meta 8); a lit redstone torch (id 76) set between them at t=2 (a power source: Block.canProvidePower) opens both through isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered, removing it at t=6 closes them. Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6).
